snippet.title: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The cargo is coming. Australia Did It launches on November 10th!

Wishlist on Steam Now! -  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396130/Australia_Did_It/

From Rami Ismail, co-creator of Nuclear Throne, Luftrausers, and Ridiculous Fishing, comes a tactical turn-based strategy game about defending trains, merging mercenaries, and building increasingly ridiculous strategies.

Nobody knows what caused it, but decades ago a catastrophic event dried up the Atlantic Ocean, leaving behind a hostile wasteland crawling with oversized bugs, reanimated ancient weapons, and bizarre mutated creatures.

Your mission? Escort our clients’ precious cargo across this hostile terrain by train. You’ll hold off endless waves of enemies at every station. If the shipment arrives intact, we’ll call it a win. 

Australia Did It will be available on PC via Steam on November 10th! Wishlist the game now and follow along on Discord or TikTok for the latest news and updates.

- Wishlist on Steam Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396130/Australia_Did_It/
- Discord: https://discord.gg/5ZvRud92eN
- Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/australiadidit.gg
- X/Twitter: https://x.com/AustraliaDidIt
